tools.name: search_coins
tools.description: Find the coin ids HiddenSwap uses, by ticker, name or network, for example "usdt tron", "monero" or "eth base". Each result gives the id to pass to the other tools, the network, whether the coin can be sent or received in a swap, whether a memo is usually needed, and the coin page when there is one.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Estimate a crypto-to-crypto swap on HiddenSwap, a no-KYC crypto exchange. Returns the amount the person would receive after all fees, the rate, the minimum and maximum, the payout fee, the usual duration and a prefilled swap link. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_coins, get_quote, get_pair_info, get_order_status · Private data: get_order_status · Public sink: search_coins, get_quote, get_pair_info, get_order_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_coins, get_quote, get_pair_info, get_order_status · Private data: get_order_status · Public sink: search_coins, get_quote, get_pair_info, get_order_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
